purpose: Read-only raw historical provenance for potential real-work evaluation fixtures; not qualified fixture packages or model-performance evidence.

Subsequently authorized: two isolated /tmp exports with separate npm caches and dependencies; fail-before/pass-after calibration executed without modifying source or target.
preparation_status: Four candidates selected; two have verified failing-parent/passing-known-fix calibration under isolated /tmp exports, while the other two remain uncalibrated. None are model-performance evidence.
limitations: Only bounded backend/debugging/audit parsing tasks are represented; these four cannot satisfy all eight proposed task classes.
Original task prompts were not recovered independently; descriptions derive from real commit/test provenance and should retain that qualification.
Historical tests are objective executable starting graders, not evidence that a model succeeds and not exhaustive task acceptance by themselves.
Hidden-solution discipline, immutable graders and source-scope enforcement must be added by the fixture packager.
Reproduction commands for uncalibrated candidates remain unexecuted; two selected candidates have retained actual calibration evidence. Setup failures remain distinct from behavioral failures.
